turns.comment: The menu is the top of the tree so there is nowhere to go back to — but *back* is a documented command, and answering it with the generic confusion line made a correct command look broken AND counted as a parse failure, nudging the customer toward the agent ladder for using the bot properly.

'done' typed at the quantity recap reads as 'I'm finished with quantities' — exactly what the toggle row does. 'notesrecap' had always accepted the word; this step hadn't, so the natural way to say it was a dead end.
Was answered with 'Pickup or delivery — which one?'. No fee yet: session.mode is still null until they answer, so this total must stay item-only.

The single most likely question at the last screen before paying, and it used to come back as 'Yes to confirm, or no to cancel?'. Now answers with the delivery-inclusive total — the number they are about to agree to.
